Food & Gourmet Store · Case study

Ruchikara

A premium gourmet, chocolate and hamper brand. The content had to look as considered as the packaging.

  • PremiumBrand positioning
  • FestiveCampaign engine
challenge

Ruchikara competes with national gourmet names on the shelf and in the feed. Its social presence needed to feel indulgent and high-end, and to spike hard through Rakshabandhan and Diwali gifting season.

approach

We built a feed of stop-motion and voiceover reels, an AI hamper promo, and festive campaign creative delivered as sets — then packaged the season into a Diwali Hampers catalogue for direct sales.

result

A gourmet feed that holds its own beside the big brands, and a festive catalogue that turned the season into orders.
